subject: Business Models
title: Everything-as-a-Service
description: A short lesson to help you apply Everything-as-a-Service.

hook.text: Lighting, heating, tires, and even airplane engines are now sold as subscriptions, not products.

buildup.text: Philips sells 'Light as a Service': businesses pay for illumination, and Philips owns and maintains the bulbs.

discovery.text: The seller keeps ownership, incentivizing durability. Why build stuff that breaks when you maintain it forever?

twist.text: This model aligns with sustainability. Manufacturers design for longevity when they bear replacement costs.

climax.text: Everything-as-a-Service could fundamentally reshape capitalism from ownership to access.

punchline.text: Own nothing, subscribe to everything. The product economy is ending.

quiz.question: Why does 'as a service' incentivize product durability?
